name: NHL 17
description: CrossCrease NHL 17. The launcher downloads the CrossCrease runtime, which includes the online connection files; you supply your own copy of the game. Play starts the base game (1.00), the version most players have; update 1.08 is optional and only meets other 1.08 players online.

settings.label: Online ID
settings.description: Your name online: 3 to 16 letters, numbers, - or _.

on_change.title: Change your online ID
on_change.action_note: Recommended. Your account keeps everything: HUT team, stats, friends and password. Online IDs can be changed once a week, and {previous} stays reserved for you for 30 days.
on_change.skip_note: Play as a different account: an online ID you already have, or a new one. {previous} keeps its HUT team and stats. Choose this too if the server operator already renamed you.

settings.label: Password
settings.description: Protects your online ID on the server: 8 to 64 characters, no \ " { or }. The first time you play with a new online ID, this becomes its password.

settings.label: Server
settings.description: Type default to use the CrossCrease server, or enter a host name or IP address.

toggles.label: Start with the game update
toggles.description: Off by default: CrossCrease plays the base game (1.00), the version most players have, so you meet everyone online. Turn it on to use the update next to the game (for example 1.08); online, update players only meet other update players. The base game cannot load a profile saved with the update; CrossCrease keeps a copy of your saves before it starts the base game.
